title: Jerome School District
description: Jerome School District 261 is a public school district located in Jerome, Idaho with an average enrollment of approximately 4,000 students. They have compromised student records (names, dates of birth, contact information, grades, attendance, disciplinary actions, special educational needs records), and employee/parent account information in PowerSchool and related systems due to a security breach. As a result, the district will violate the Educational Privacy Act (FERPA), the Idaho Student Accessibility, Transparency, and Accountability Act, and the breach notification provisions of the Idaho Identity Theft Act.
